LanguageData.VME_ViolentConversion.label: crusading zeal
LanguageData.VME_ViolentConversion.description: Only one creed can rebuild the wastes. Those who reject it must be brought into the fold, by persuasion when possible and by force when necessary.
LanguageData.VME_Astrology.label: star alignment
LanguageData.VME_Astrology.description: Cosmic alignments, old-world star charts, and signs in the poisoned sky reveal patterns that guide our lives.
LanguageData.VME_GodEmperor.label: living icon
LanguageData.VME_GodEmperor.description: Our leader is the living embodiment of the cause. Their word carries the weight of law, prophecy, and legend.
LanguageData.VME_HardcoreIndustrialism.label: foundry doctrine
LanguageData.VME_HardcoreIndustrialism.description: Forges, mills, and assembly lines are the foundation of power. Everyone must keep the foundry running and earn their place through production.
LanguageData.VME_Gestalt.label: collective consciousness
LanguageData.VME_Gestalt.description: Separate wills create weakness. Survival demands a people who think, labor, and sacrifice as one unified whole.
LanguageData.VME_Fleshcrafters.label: forced evolution
LanguageData.VME_Fleshcrafters.description: The human form is only raw material. Through mutation, surgery, and ruthless experimentation, we will force the next stage of evolution.
LanguageData.VME_HolyDiseases.label: sacred affliction
LanguageData.VME_HolyDiseases.description: Disease, mutation, and bodily decay are not merely suffering. They are trials that mark the chosen and transform the faithful.
LanguageData.VME_CraftCulture.label: masterwork tradition
LanguageData.VME_CraftCulture.description: A weapon, tool, or suit of armor carries its maker's reputation. Masterwork craftsmanship is how knowledge survives the ruins.
LanguageData.VME_Progressive.label: automated future
LanguageData.VME_Progressive.description: Machines should bear the burden of labor. Automation will free our people to direct, invent, and build a future beyond mere survival.
LanguageData.VME_Aristocratic.label: old-world elite
LanguageData.VME_Aristocratic.description: Leadership belongs to those with breeding, education, wealth, or inherited authority. The masses prosper when the proven elite command.
LanguageData.VME_ExaltedPriesthood.label: prophet rule
LanguageData.VME_ExaltedPriesthood.description: Temporal and spiritual authority must rest in the same hands. Our leader interprets the faith and commands the community.
LanguageData.VME_Vegan.label: wasteland agrarianism
LanguageData.VME_Vegan.description: Crops, fungi, and hardy wasteland plants should sustain us. Raising and slaughtering animals for food is wasteful and wrong.
LanguageData.VME_FireWorship.label: flame cult
LanguageData.VME_FireWorship.description: Flame purifies corruption, drives back the dark, and carries judgment to the enemies of the faithful.
LanguageData.VME_Bushido.label: warrior code
LanguageData.VME_Bushido.description: Discipline, loyalty, and courage give violence meaning. A warrior's conduct matters as much as victory.
LanguageData.VME_Light.label: bright faith
LanguageData.VME_Light.description: Light is a promise of safety and revelation in a darkened world. We keep it burning and reject those who embrace the shadows.
LanguageData.VME_BloodCourt.label: rule by strength
LanguageData.VME_BloodCourt.description: Authority must be proven in direct struggle. A leader who cannot defend the title has no right to keep it.
LanguageData.VME_CityBuilders.label: settlement builders
LanguageData.VME_CityBuilders.description: Permanent walls, workshops, roads, and public spaces turn a camp of survivors into a civilization worth defending.
LanguageData.VME_MechanoidSupremacy.label: machine supremacy
LanguageData.VME_MechanoidSupremacy.description: Machines surpass fragile flesh in endurance, precision, and purpose. Humanity should learn from them, serve them, or become like them.
LanguageData.VME_PartyLife.label: wasteland revelry
LanguageData.VME_PartyLife.description: Life in the wastes is short and brutal. Music, drink, chems, and crowded celebrations remind us why survival matters.
LanguageData.VME_Nationalist.label: wasteland nationalism
LanguageData.VME_Nationalist.description: Our flag, territory, and people come first. Unity must be defended against foreign influence, internal division, and disloyalty.
LanguageData.VME_InsectoidSupremacy.label: AntAgonizer doctrine
LanguageData.VME_InsectoidSupremacy.description: Giant ants endured the bombs, radiation, and poisoned soil by acting as one disciplined colony. Their queen, workers, and soldiers embody a unity that scattered humanity has forgotten. Followers revere the ants, imitate their castes, and entrust trained AntAgonizers to condition wild specimens and establish controlled nests.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Esotericism.label: forbidden lore
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Esotericism.description: Pre-War ruins conceal knowledge that governments, corporations, and cults tried to bury. Only initiated seekers dare uncover and master it.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Bacchanalianism.label: wasteland hedonism
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Bacchanalianism.descriptio: New Reno and the Strip proved that pleasure can outlive the old world. Denying drink, chems, gambling, lust, or luxury is denying the point of survival.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_ChthonianCult.label: Ug-Qualtoth cult
LanguageData.VME_Structure_ChthonianCult.description: Something ancient stirs beneath sacred sites and forgotten mines. Through offerings and forbidden rites, we seek the favor of Ug-Qualtoth and powers like it.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Eschatologism.label: atomic doomsday cult
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Eschatologism.description: The Great War was revelation, not accident. Famine, plague, mutation, and atomic fire are signs that the final cleansing has already begun.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Authoritarianism.label: iron rule
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Authoritarianism.descripti: Debate and divided authority invite collapse. A single chain of command, backed by force, is the only reliable defense against chaos.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_CultOfPersonality.label: cult of personality
LanguageData.VME_Structure_CultOfPersonality.descript: The nation is embodied by its supreme leader. Their image, victories, and words bind the people together and may never be questioned.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Omnism.label: wasteland syncretism
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Omnism.description: Every surviving creed carries fragments of truth and old mistakes. Wisdom comes from combining what endured instead of obeying a single tradition.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Shintaoism.label: Shi doctrine
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Shintaoism.description: Descended from Chinese traditions and the teachings preserved by the Shi, this order joins discipline, ancestral wisdom, science, and social harmony.
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Corporate.label: old-world corporate order
LanguageData.VME_Structure_Corporate.description: The company is the state. Executives set policy, workers earn their privileges, and every resource must produce a measurable return.
